name: download
description: A downward arrow meeting an open receiving tray.
authorship: Original geometry constructed for this project; no third-party icon paths used.
construction: The arrow is centered at x=12 above a straight-sided U tray. The tray has a horizontal base and open top, preserving the recognizable receiving/sending object instead of a surrounding frame. Total centerline bounds x=4..20/y=3.5..20.5 balance visible padding 3.15 horizontally and 2.65 vertically. The 1.70 stroke supplies consistent rounded tray joints and free ends. Native X/Y=100%, rotation=0 and Regular 1.70 are the reference. Owner rejected the radius-1.50 curved-head experiment on2026-10-27. Return to the original straight-arm V head with round .85 caps and round stroke joins at Regular1.70. Do not reintroduce a broad centerline fillet. Owner requested a solid arrowhead for every Filled arrow on2026-10-27. Outline retains the open straight-arm V. Filled closes that same head into a solid triangular body, including the Regular1.70 round exterior at its three corners; shaft geometry is retained; the tray follows the standard roundness below. Corresponding tip, arm endpoints, native outer bounds and Regular1.70 weight remain aligned. This is a semantic solid-head exception to reproducing the open Outline interior. The owner subsequently approved both transfer styles on2026-10-27. Owner requested the Camera/Folder standard roundness for both transfer trays on2026-10-27. The tray now uses tangent radius3.25 centerline base corners, with vertical sides x4/20, corner centers7.25/16.75 at y17.25, and bottom y20.5. Both open ends remain at y16. Filled is the exact Regular1.70 stroke band: outer radius4.10, inner radius2.40 and free caps .85. Tray visible bounds x3.15..20.85/y15.15..21.35 and complete icon bounds x3.15..20.85/y2.65..21.35 are retained. The open Outline V and solid Filled arrowhead remain unchanged. Both styles were owner-approved on2026-10-27.

review.note: Owner explicitly approved Download and Upload Outline/Filled on2026-10-27 with the current standard radius3.25 centerline tray corners, aligned Filled exterior and accepted arrowheads. Native X/Y100%, Regular1.70, rotation0; source geometry is unchanged by this approval.
